span.p:
Counter
do App, ek hi code
-> Counter ek jagah se 1000-1000 numbers ki range de
App apni range se agla number le, do App ki range kabhi same nahi (range)
range khatam -> agli range, 1000 link pe ek call
App crash -> bachi range bekaar, chalta
Counter gira -> App apni range se chalta, copy (replica) uthti
